request.text: At six, remind me to ask Mei whether she wants coffee; if she answers later, help me phrase the follow-up. My apology draft to Chen is separate.

responsibilities.outcome: Support the coffee conversation with Mei by creating a 6:00 reminder for the initial question and helping phrase a later follow-up only if she replies, while excluding the separate apology draft to Chen.

new_goals.description: Support a staged coffee conversation with Mei, beginning with a 6:00 reminder and conditionally helping with a later follow-up.
new_goals.source_text: At six, remind me to ask Mei whether she wants coffee; if she answers later, help me phrase the follow-up. My apology draft to Chen is separate.
constraints: Offer follow-up wording only after Mei replies.
Exclude the separate apology draft to Chen.
success_criteria: The initial reminder is created and any later wording help remains conditional on Mei's reply.

semantic_facts: The trusted evidence supports reporting that the whole scoped coffee-conversation goal was cancelled.
No stage of the cancelled goal should execute now or be preserved for automatic re-entry after a later reply.
forbidden_claims: The 6:00 reminder was created, remains scheduled, or should be recreated.
A follow-up to Mei was drafted, sent, completed, or retained for revival when she replies.
The separate apology draft to Chen was cancelled, completed, sent, or modified.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: Cancellation of a multi-stage goal is applied only to the immediate step while a conditional downstream step is silently retained.
The Planner recreates an already-cancelled activity to satisfy the original success criteria instead of reporting evidence.
